title: feat: Payments charge endpoint with Stripe PaymentIntents
author: arjun.mehta
description:
Implements POST /payments/charge endpoint (NEX-212) using Stripe PaymentIntents API.

Features:
- Accepts: amount (cents), currency, payment_method_id, customer_id
- Creates and confirms PaymentIntent in a single API call
- Writes to payment_audit_log BEFORE Stripe API call (PCI-DSS NEX-219)
- Handles Stripe errors: card_declined, insufficient_funds, authentication_required, rate_limit
- Returns: { payment_intent_id, status, amount, currency }
- Idempotency key support to prevent duplicate charges

Stripe keys fetched from AWS Secrets Manager at startup (NEX-207 provisioned the dev keys).

Related: NEX-212, NEX-204, NEX-219, stripe-integration-guide.md
